phone_result: User-confirmed white fade correlates with drop in render submissions and physical presentations; GPU top-to-scene-end interval increases while draw count decreases; recovery captured. Those elapsed intervals include synchronization stalls, not shader-only work.
solid_trial: Two desktop GPUs, five white alpha values, pixel-identical, sync validation errors 0. Unconsumed vertex output warnings preserved in logs. Candidate skips texture sampling and uses ordinary premultiplied normal blending; one additional draw. No phone adoption or claim of fixing phone flash.
native_trial_extended: Two GPUs, 24 clip/shear/flipped UV/nearest-linear-repeat/blend/float-color pixel cases each, exact; sync errors 0.
timestamp_probe: Four GPU timestamps: top, first color-output stage marker, scene bottom, present bottom. Keeps old total, adds leading/trailing intervals and per-window maxima. Stage placement can be later on implementations; not an exact standalone semaphore-wait measurement. Synchronization unchanged.
